blockers.wanted: a crackle-amount knob held to a density claim
blockers.tried: claim density on a macro mapping the crackle noise node's density 15..200
blockers.workaround: left the macro unclaimed; density reads 210-670 events/s of the broadband whoosh and varies by seed regardless of the crackle layer

blockers.wanted: tell whether a faint crackle layer is present under a decaying whoosh
blockers.tried: fine onset count; it flipped between 1 and 9 with small level changes
blockers.workaround: judged from the spectrogram and the centroid by tenth only; no per-layer measure

wishlist: a ready match / flame-ignition node (scrape + flare + crackle)
a 'listen node' style per-layer onset count or a way to mute layers in listen
macro map entries for env points (flare length)
what_worked: env breakpoint nodes shaped each layer in one node
friction with roughness 1 gave a usable scrape source with no modal
peak_db plus fade_in 0.0005 delivered -3.0 dBFS exactly
